cases.name: integer and null
cases.sql: SELECT 42::INTEGER AS n, NULL::VARCHAR AS empty

cases.name: representative native types
cases.sql: SELECT 9007199254740993::BIGINT AS big, 12.34::DECIMAL(10,2) AS amount, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 01:02:03' AS time

cases.name: histogram arithmetic
cases.sql: SELECT floor(i / 10) * 10 AS bin, count(*) AS count FROM conformance_numbers WHERE isfinite(i) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.name: precise and temporal types
cases.sql: SELECT 18446744073709551615::UBIGINT AS unsigned, 12345678901234567890.123456789::DECIMAL(38,9) AS precise, DATE '2024-02-29' AS date, TIMESTAMP_NS '2026-01-01 01:02:03.123456789' AS nanos, CAST(INTERVAL '2 months 3 days 4 microseconds' AS VARCHAR) AS duration, '\x00\xff'::BLOB AS bytes

cases.name: date histogram interval
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 day, DATE '2026-01-05') AS x1, time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 day, DATE '2026-01-05') + INTERVAL 1 day AS x2

cases.name: categorical summary CTE
cases.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT i % 10 AS category, count(*) AS n FROM conformance_numbers GROUP BY 1) SELECT category, sum(n) AS total FROM counts GROUP BY category
